comment: The named remainder of the 2026-09-02 untangle: every import-cycle edge the boundary control tolerates, beside the boundary it violates. 52 back-edges were cut to these 2. Retire entries by breaking the cycle; never add one without its reason.

reasons.gates<->writers: The close-out pair: gates asks writers whether the session declared itself releasable (sessionIsReleasable), and writers asks gates what the worktree materially changed before allowing a declaration (materialWorktreeChanges). Both are close-out workflow internals; the split belongs to the workflow-boundary session that gives close-out its own context.
